notes.title: New Gameplay Trailer
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=-RhPLReIwCU;full][/previewyoutube]
After lots of hard work in 2024, we are proud to present gameplay footage of the roguelike gamemode. 

We are planning to follow up with more footage explaining the game's mechanics as well as a demo before a full release. 

Enjoy.

notes.title: Progress Report
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731150/9bd914579ae6c036bdfbaf9842490b502ba3be28.gif[/img]

Over the last 7 months we've been hard at work on all fronts. A lot of which you can see on display in our new steam trailer.

If you like, you can read a little more of the recent changes on our website. Read the latest update [url=https://www.deathandtactics.com/post/10-6-month-progress-report]here.[/url]

As ever, we are still committed to delivering a polished and complete product. So for now, we appreciate the patience as we work behind the scenes to experiment and test. We will update more frequently as we have more to share.

-Ken
